title: bl_forge.target applies forge_project to every repository of a multi-repository workspace, so land can read the workspace's request as each repository's
goal: In a workspace whose backlog.json declares repositories, a repository checkout's request read names that repository's own project (its origin URL), never forge_project, or check refuses forge_project beside a repositories map

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
os.environ.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None);sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_base,bl_forge,kbpublic
w=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(w/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"forge_project":"team/workspace","repositories":{"api":"api"}}))
a=w/"api";a.mkdir();g=lambda *x:s.run(["git","-C",str(a),*x],check=True,capture_output=True)
g("init","-q");g("remote","add",kbpublic.integration_remote(str(a)),"https://gitlab.com/team/api.git")
v=bl_base.load_settings(str(w))
try:p=bl_forge.target(str(a)).project
except bl_base.Refused as e:p="refused: %s"%e
c=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",str(w),"check"],capture_output=True,text=True);refused=any("forge_project" in x for x in v[3]) or (c.returncode!=0 and "forge_project" in c.stdout+c.stderr)
print("repository api reads project:",p,"| settings refuse forge_project beside repositories:",refused)
sys.exit(0 if p=="team/api" or refused else 1)

repro_reason: the failure needs a forge with two projects; the text shows bl_forge.target has no per-repository branch

clauses.clause: In a workspace whose backlog.json declares repositories, a repository checkout's request read names that repository's own project (its origin URL), never forge_project, or check refuses forge_project beside a repositories map
